newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa c.bank ready to sign $1.5 bln loan - paper.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa c.bank ready to sign $1.5 bln loan - paper.

text.p: South Africa's Reserve Bank will sign a $1.5 billion syndicated loan with a group of international banks in London next week, Business Report quoted Bank Governor Chris Stals telling a lunch in Pretoria.

The central bank announced in June that it had completed the first phase of talks in establishing the medium-term revolving credit facility. The Bank said at the time that 12 banks were arranging the facility.
Officials say the loan should help inspire more confidence in South Africa's ability to provide liquidity when and if needed by the foreign exchange market.
